research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Asserts is focused on developing systems that enhance observability by automatically monitoring applications and generating insights. Their technology involves creating knowledge graphs to model and correlate data, eliminating the need for manual identification of application components to monitor. This approach allows for flexible deployment across various environments, aligning with Asserts' goal of transforming Prometheus metrics into actionable root cause insights.

about_short_description.short_description: Asserts is an Observability intelligence platform that transforms your Prometheus metrics into root cause insights.

product.name: Asserts Correlation Intelligence™
product.description: Analyzes Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics, traces, and metadata to build a dynamic entity graph that correlates related application and infrastructure components for root cause identification.

product.name: Asserts Knowledge Base™
product.description: A curated library of PromQL recording and alerting rules that continuously scans time-series data to detect common runtime failure patterns and presents findings in a structured assertion model.

product.name: Asserts Data Distiller™
product.description: Processes and compresses high-cardinality Prometheus metrics and traces to retain only essential data, significantly reducing ingestion and long-term storage costs.

product.name: Asserts Intelligent Workbench™
product.description: An automated analysis tool that correlates metrics, traces, and alerts into a unified dashboard to quickly identify and troubleshoot issues affecting service health and SLOs.

product.name: SLO Management and Alerting
product.description: Enables definition, tracking, and alerting on Service Level Objectives (SLOs) based on Prometheus metrics to align monitoring with business objectives and reduce alert noise.
